instructions.question: buy, sell, or hold {{asset}}?
instructions.goal: One maker quote for this book and this inventory. hold means no new order.
instructions.inputs: state is a short line of adjectives in a fixed order: spread depth flow tape inventory funding clock. inventory is {{stance}}.
instructions.context: size, price, time in force and leverage are chosen by the code, never by you.

criteria.buy: Maker edge to buy: flow is lift, meaning aggression is on the buy side. Or tape is pumping, meaning the short window moved up hard. flow two_way, or tape grinding or flat, is not a direction by itself.
criteria.sell: Maker edge to sell: flow is dump, meaning aggression is on the sell side. Or tape is dumping, meaning the short window moved down hard. flow two_way, or tape grinding or flat, is not a direction by itself.
criteria.hold: No edge: tape is flat, or inventory already expresses the view, or the book is too hostile to send any non-reduce order.

instructions.question: Is this book too hostile to send any non-reduce order?
instructions.inputs: state is the same short line of adjectives. inventory is {{stance}}.
instructions.context: Answer yes only for a book where a resting quote would be obvious food. The spread bucket and the tape bucket decide this. The flow bucket on its own does not.

criteria.true: spread is unfillable, or tape is violent.
criteria.false: spread is tight, normal or wide, and tape is not violent. flow bot_war on its own does not make a book hostile.
